lines.en: label makiinvite1:
I tap on Maki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Maki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure how Ami will handle me inviting over the mother of her arch nemesis, but I’ll be damned if I let an obnoxious girl with A-cups rule my life.
lines.zh: 我不太确定 Ami 会怎么消化「我把她死对头的母亲请上门」这件事，但要说我会让一个 A 杯的烦人丫头主宰我的人生——那是不可能的。

lines.en: I am an adult looking for another adult to do adult things with- and Maki is the only adult I know who is very rarely busy with anything since her daughter can just take over.
lines.zh: 我是个成年人，想找另一个成年人做点成年人的事——而 Maki 是我认识的唯一一个几乎从不忙的成年人，反正她女儿随时能顶班。

lines.en: I mean, I guess Sara would also work, but I feel like it’s a lot easier to sell porn than it is to revitalize a failing bar. No offense, Sana.
lines.zh: 我是说，Sara 大概也行，但我觉得卖色情片总比拯救一家快倒闭的酒吧容易多了。无意冒犯，Sana。

lines.en: : Gangbang hotline, this is Maki speaking.

lines.zh: : 当然。来一份 Maki。

lines.en: : Just don’t be too weird in front of my [niece]. She already kind of hates your daughter, so you’re kind of starting off on thin ice.
lines.zh: : 只是在我 [niece] 面前别太怪就行。她本来就挺讨厌你女儿的，所以你算是开局就踩在薄冰上。

lines.en: : What? Why would anyone ever hate Makoto? Makoto is great.
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么会有人讨厌 Makoto？Makoto 多好啊。

lines.en: : I hope your [niece] is ready to throw hands.
lines.zh: : 那我希望你 [niece] 已经准备好动手了。

lines.zh: : 那我该带多少润滑剂-

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and quickly text Maki my address.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，迅速把地址发给了 Maki。

lines.en: I feel mostly safe in assuming that she won’t actually be bringing any lube, but I ask her to leave everything behind in the event that she just...doesn't care about anything I say.
lines.zh: 我基本可以放心地假定她不会真带润滑剂来，但我还是让她什么都别带，以防她……压根不在乎我说什么。

lines.en: It’s one thing bringing an older, lazier looking Makoto over to the house, but having her come equipped with what I imagine is an entire collection of lubricant would be too hard for even me to get out of.
lines.zh: 把一个更年长、看着更懒散的 Maki 带回家里是一回事，可要是她带着我想象中那一整箱润滑剂登门，那就连我都圆不回来了。

lines.en: Either way, I wait for Maki to confirm that she’s on her way over and slide my phone back into my pocket before setting course home.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我等 Maki 确认她已经在过来的路上，然后把手机塞回口袋，动身回家。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv1
I make my way inside and prepare myself for what I hope will be a rather easy and dramaless night in.
lines.zh: 我走进屋，为即将到来的、我希望会相当轻松且毫无波折的一晚做好准备。

lines.en: : Get out of here!
lines.zh: : 给我滚出去！

lines.en: It appears that will not be the case.
lines.zh: 看来事情并不是这样。

lines.en: : I don’t know what I did, but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道我做错了什么，可是-

lines.en: : You mean to tell me that for only 1,000 yen a month, I can get all of the lotion I want?!
lines.zh: : 你是说，只要每月一千日元，我就能想要多少乳液就有多少？！

lines.en: : That’s right, Ami! And this isn’t just any lotion...it’s lotion guaranteed to keep you looking [young]and energetic for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 没错，Ami！而且这可不是普通的乳液……这是保证能让你永远看上去 [young]and energetic 的乳液。

lines.en: : Ahh, that’s even better! My [uncle]’s not home right now so he won’t get mad at me for saying this, but he really seems to like [younger_girls].
lines.zh: : 啊，那就更好了！我 [uncle] 现在不在家，所以我这么说他也听不见，不过他好像真的很喜欢 [younger_girls]。

lines.en: : Does he now? Well, then I...totally understand why you’d want him to look at you that way!
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我……就完全理解你为什么想让他那样看你了！

lines.en: scene black
Maybe I should just come back later.
lines.zh: 也许我应该晚点再来。

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei?! Is that you or did somebody break in?!
lines.zh: : 等等，老师？！是你吗，还是有人闯进来了？！

lines.en: scene makifirstinv2
: Hah...Hi, Ami. And hi-
lines.zh: : 哈……你好，Ami。还有你-

lines.en: : Felicity Fellatio, at your service!
lines.zh: : Felicity Fellatio，为您效劳！

lines.en: : Sensei! Miss Fellatio says that for only 1,000 yen a month, I can have all the lotion I want!
lines.zh: : 老师！Fellatio 小姐说，只要每月一千日元，我就能想要多少乳液就有多少！

lines.en: : Can I borrow 1,000 yen a month so I can be pretty forever?
lines.zh: : 我能每个月借一千日元吗，这样我就能永远漂亮下去了？

lines.en: : You have a job now. Use your own money.
lines.zh: : 你现在有工作了。花你自己的钱。

lines.en: : Also, don’t you think her last name is kind of suspicious?
lines.zh: : 还有，你不觉得她的姓有点可疑吗？

lines.zh: : 嗯？Fellatio 不是一种……意大利甜点之类的吗？别这么没有文化包容心啊，老师。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv3
: Now, I know what you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 现在，我知道你在想什么。

lines.en: : Do you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真知道吗？

lines.en: : Of course! You’re thinking...“Wow! Only 1,000 yen a month?! What a steal!”
lines.zh: : 当然！你在想……“哇！只要每月一千日元？！太划算了！”

lines.en: : Well, let me tell you this, buddy. It really all starts to make sense when you take a look at our business model.
lines.zh: : 那我告诉你吧，老兄。等你看看我们的商业模式，一切就说得通了。

lines.en: : You don’t even have any products with you.
lines.zh: : 你连产品都没带。

lines.en: : She showed up with a whole suitcase of all different kinds of exotic lotions.
lines.zh: : 她带着一整箱各种各样异国风情的乳液上门了。

lines.en: : I thought it was a little strange when she knocked since we don’t really get a lot of door to door salespeople around here, but as soon as I smelled what was inside, I immediately knew what was going on.
lines.zh: : 她敲门的时候我就觉得有点怪，毕竟这一带很少有上门推销的，可我一闻到箱子里那股味儿，立刻就明白是怎么回事了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you did, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你明白了，Ami。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv4
: Oh my. It appears we may have a bit of a skeptic on our hands!
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来我们遇上了一位怀疑论者！

lines.zh: : 那么，这位素不相识的先生，要不要试试我这款独一无二的异国护手乳液？

: Wait, you were expecting her, Sensei? Did you set up an appointment thingy with this lady?

lines.zh: : 我的生日还早着呢，所以-

: Wait, is this an early Christmas present?! You’re getting me a lifetime supply of youthful lotion so I can stay adorable forever?!

lines.en: : No. This is actually Makoto’s mom and her suitcase is full of a bunch of stuff that is most definitely not lotion.
lines.zh: : 不是。这位其实是 Makoto 的妈妈，她那箱子里装的一堆东西绝对不是乳液。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Why didn’t you just go along with it?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不顺着说下去？

lines.en: : Better question, how did you manage to get here before me?
lines.zh: : 更好的问题是，你是怎么比我先到的？

lines.en: scene makifirstinv7
: I just happened to be making my rounds in the area as a totally legitimate lotion sales rep! And since you scheduled an appointment with me, I was always going to show up.
lines.zh: : 我刚好作为一名完全合法的乳液推销员在这一带跑业务！而且既然你跟我约好了，我就一定会来的。

lines.en: : Sensei, would you mind explaining to me what is going on here?
lines.zh: : 老师，你能给我解释一下这到底是怎么回事吗？

lines.en: : I kind of did already.
lines.zh: : 我刚才已经解释得差不多了。

lines.en: : So this actually is Makoto’s mom?
lines.zh: : 所以这位真的是 Makoto 的妈妈？

lines.en: scene makifirstinv8
: Uhh...yes! But just because I lied about my name doesn’t mean I lied about the product!
lines.zh: : 呃……是的！但我在名字上撒谎，不代表我在产品上也撒谎了！

lines.en: : I thought you looked familiar...
lines.zh: : 我就觉得你看着眼熟……

lines.en: : Maki, why are you still so focused on selling a product that doesn’t even exist?
lines.zh: : Maki，你为什么还这么执着于推销一个根本不存在的产品？

lines.en: scene makifirstinv9
: It’s in my blood, obviously! My job is to sell things! And sometimes, in order to sell things, you need to lie about them!
lines.zh: : 这显然是我的天性！我的工作就是卖东西！而有时候，为了把东西卖出去，你就得对它们撒谎！

lines.en: : “Excuse me, miss, but does this vibrator have multiple speeds?” “Why, of course it does! Just don’t read the part of the box that says it only has one!”
lines.zh: : “不好意思，小姐，请问这根振动棒有多档调速吗？”“哎呀，当然有！只要别去看包装盒上写着只有一档的那部分就行！”

lines.en: : “Excuse me, miss, but my wrists are very sensitive. Do you have any velcro handcuffs?” “Why, of course I do! Because that product totally exists!”

: Corn! Canned! Cobbed! Creamed! Any type of-

: Pfft~

Perhaps I should have played along.

lines.zh: 而且你知道吗，换一个人生，我说不定真会。

lines.en: But as Ami’s legal guardian and a man who, on several occasions, has let her borrow my credit card, I refuse to allow her to get sucked into a fictional pyramid scheme.
lines.zh: 但作为 Ami 的法定监护人，而且是个曾经好几次把信用卡借给她刷的男人，我绝不允许她被一个虚构的传销骗局套进去。

lines.zh: 哪怕这意味着判她一辈子都讨厌 Makoto 的母亲——反正这事我猜迟早也会发生。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv12
: You betrayed me! I invite you into my house because your suitcase smells good and this is how you repay me?!
lines.zh: : 你背叛我！我因为你的箱子好闻才请你进门，你就是这么报答我的？！

lines.zh: : 滚出去，永远别再回来！

lines.zh: : 好！我承认！我利用了你的信任，让你相信我这箱润滑油是一箱乳液！

lines.en: : Ami, come on. You can’t just elect to believe the door to door part of her story. It’s clearly all part of a coordinated effort to-
lines.zh: : Ami，拜托。你不能只挑“挨家挨户”这一部分来相信吧。这明显是一整套配合好的-

: How many more Miyamuras are you going to invite into this household, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你还打算往这个家里再请几个 Miyamura 家的人？

lines.en: : If you wind up inviting a third, can you ask him to at least come say hello to his daughter? She misses him.
lines.zh: : 要是你最后真请了第三个，能不能让他至少来跟他女儿打个招呼？她很想他。

lines.en: : I’m not inviting any other Miyamuras over to the house. One was more than enough and that still didn’t deter me from bringing in Maki and her lube collection.
lines.zh: : 我不会再请别的 Miyamura 来家里了。一个就已经够受了，可那也没能阻止我把 Maki 和她那箱润滑油带进来。

lines.en: : Heh. You said lube.

: Get out of my house, you harlot!

lines.zh: : 荡妇？现在是在演文艺复兴吗？有点骨气好不好，像普通女孩一样叫我妓女。

lines.en: : I can’t tell which of you is worse! You or Makoto!
lines.zh: : 我分不清你们俩谁更糟！是你还是 Makoto！

lines.en: : Me, obviously. Makoto is just the prettier, smarter, less sexually confident version. And if there is anything worth admiring in today’s political climate, it is a lack of sexual confidence.
lines.zh: : 显然是我。Makoto 不过是个更漂亮、更聪明、床上更没自信的版本。而且在当今这种政治气候下，如果说还有什么值得称道的，那就是缺乏性自信。

lines.en: : And also a surplus of sexual confidence. As long as it’s one or the other, things’ll be good.
lines.zh: : 当然，性自信过剩也值得称道。只要占其中一样，事情就好办了。

lines.en: : Anyway, were you going to buy any lotion or should I start packing my things?
lines.zh: : 总之，你到底要不要买点乳液，还是我开始收拾东西了？

lines.en: : You’re not planning on leaving already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会这就打算走了吧？

lines.en: scene makifirstinv15
: Why do you want her here when you have me?!
lines.zh: : 你都有我了，为什么还要她在这儿？！

lines.en: : You’re actually okay with me staying?
lines.zh: : 你是说你真不介意我留下？

lines.zh: : 那你就打包票打错了。

lines.en: : Besides, this gives me the opportunity to try something I’ve been wanting to try for a long time now.
lines.zh: : 再说了，这也给了我机会，去试一件我想了很久的事。

lines.en: : I hope it involves lube, because I brought plenty.
lines.zh: : 我希望那跟润滑油有关，因为我带了很多。

lines.en: : You can’t be serious!
lines.zh: : 你不会是认真的吧！

lines.en: : I am serious. In fact...I am so serious, that I am, going to do this.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。事实上……我认真到，我就要，这么做了。

lines.en: : Lay one finger on her and she’ll be leaving this house in a variety of different bags!
lines.zh: : 你敢碰她一根手指，她就得分好几个袋子离开这个家！

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami-

: You didn’t...
lines.zh: : 你不会……

lines.en: : Hah. Get parented, loser.
lines.zh: : 哈。被当家长的管了吧，输家。

lines.en: : Right now, [young]lady.
lines.zh: : 现在就去，[young]lady。

lines.en: I do my best to put on an adult voice, but I’m pretty sure it’s just my normal voice.
lines.zh: 我尽力装出一个大人的腔调，不过我敢肯定那就是我的正常声音。

lines.en: Probably because I’m an adult.
lines.zh: 大概因为我本来就是个大人。

lines.en: : You...
: Why do I...actually feel compelled to go to my room?...
lines.zh: : 为什么我……真的有种非回房间不可的感觉？……

lines.en: : Because starting right now, you are grounded.
lines.zh: : 因为从现在开始，你被禁足了。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv17
: For...for how long?!
lines.zh: : 到……到什么时候？！

lines.en: : Until Maki leaves. After that, you can do whatever.
lines.zh: : 直到 Maki 离开为止。之后你爱干嘛干嘛。

lines.en: : Why am I in trouble when all I wanted to do was protect your honor?!
lines.zh: : 我明明只是想保护你的名誉，为什么要受罚？！

lines.zh: : 小心点，不然他真把你禁足了。

lines.zh: : Ami。回房间。

: GRAAAAAAH! I STILL HATE YOU AND YOUR STUPID DAUGHTER!

Ami [[miraculously] goes into her room and slams the door behind her.
lines.zh: Ami [[miraculously] 走进自己的房间，然后砰地一声关上了门。

lines.en: And, in other news, I gained a new power today.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条新闻：我今天获得了一项新能力。

lines.en: : You know, if I knew this was going to turn into a whole thing, I would have just left the lube behind.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，早知道会闹成这样，我就把润滑油留在家里了。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv20
: You mean like I asked you to?
lines.zh: : 你是说，就像我要求的那样？

lines.en: : I thought that was a joke. I wasn’t about to miss out on an opportunity to break out the travel lube. Do you have any idea how long it’s been since I got to show that to anyone?
lines.zh: : 我以为那是句玩笑。我可不想错过一个拿出旅行装润滑油的机会。你知道我多久没把这东西拿出来给人看过了吗？

lines.en: : Cause it’s been a long time, Sensei. A long time.
lines.zh: : 因为真的很久了，老师。很久很久。

lines.en: : That aside, I think it’s safe to assume Ami hates you now.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我觉得基本可以断定 Ami 现在恨你了。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv21
: Excellent.
lines.zh: : 好极了。

lines.en: : Why is that excellent? Normally, when you get invited over to a person’s house, you’re supposed to try to not make them hate you.
lines.zh: : 这有什么好极了的？一般来说，被人请到家里做客，你应该尽量别让对方恨你才对。

lines.en: : Normally, yes. But I came here with the knowledge that, for some reason, your fake daughter has a problem with my real daughter.
lines.zh: : 一般来说是这样。但我来之前就知道，不知为什么，你那个假女儿跟我这个真女儿过不去。

lines.en: : She is my [niece], not my daughter.
lines.zh: : 她是我 [niece]，不是我女儿。

lines.en: : I bet she calls you Daddy in her fantasies.
lines.zh: : 我打赌她在幻想里会叫你爸爸。

lines.en: if amimaster.lower() in ["daddy"]:
I mean...she calls me that in a lot more than just her fantasies.
lines.zh: 我是说……她可不止在幻想里那么叫我。

lines.en: But even if that’s the case, I can’t let Maki actually believe it.
lines.zh: 但就算如此，我也不能让 Maki 真信了。

lines.en: : Her real dad is actually dead, so...probably not.
lines.zh: : 她亲爸其实已经死了，所以……大概不会吧。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv22
: Oh...crap.
lines.zh: : 哦……糟了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to bring up bad memories.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我不是故意提起伤心事。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I don’t have many memories of it in the first place.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我对那事本来也没什么记忆。

lines.en: scene amiani4
scene makifirstinv22
: Either way, I crossed a line and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我越线了，对不起。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv23
: But, uhh...what I meant by the whole “excellent” comment is that now, by comparison, Ami will probably hate me a little more than Makoto.
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……我说“好极了”的意思是，这么一对比，Ami 现在大概会比讨厌 Makoto 更讨厌我一点。

lines.en: : That wasn’t your plan from the start, was it?
lines.zh: : 这不是你一开始的计划吧？

lines.en: scene makifirstinv24
: No. I just wanted to hang out and talk and maybe show off all of my cool lubes.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是想出来玩、聊聊天，顺便炫耀一下我那些很酷的润滑油。

lines.en: : But halfway through my sales pitch, I started thinking, “You know what? This is probably going to go south eventually.”
lines.zh: : 可推销到一半，我开始想：“你知道吗？这事八成早晚要黄。”

lines.en: : In my defense, though, if you hadn’t taken your sweet ass time getting over here, this never would have happened.
lines.zh: : 不过替我自己说句公道话，如果你不是慢悠悠地磨蹭半天才过来，这事根本不会发生。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I came right over after I called you.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我打完电话就直接过来了。

lines.en: : Well then I guess I’m just super fast and you’re the human equivalent of a turtle.
lines.zh: : 那看来就是我太快了，而你是人类版的乌龟。

lines.en: : Anyway, want to go get dinner or something? It’s nice being invited over, but it feels a little strange when your [niece] likely has her ear to the door to make sure we’re not having sex.
lines.zh: : 总之，要去吃个晚饭什么的吗？被请来做客挺好的，可一想到你 [niece] 大概正把耳朵贴在门上，确认我们有没有在做爱，感觉就有点怪。

lines.en: : THAT’S RIGHT! RUN AWAY, MAKOTO’S MOM! THIS HOUSE BELONGS TO THE ARAKAWAS!
lines.zh: : 没错！快滚吧，Makoto 的妈妈！这个家姓荒川！

lines.en: : See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 明白我的意思了吧？

lines.en: : You’ll grow to accept her in due time. Ami just has a very strong sense of family values.
lines.zh: : 你迟早会习惯她的。Ami 只是家庭观念特别强。

lines.en: if amilust15 == True:
In fact, it’s so strong that sometimes she even starts masturbating in my bed while I’m asleep.
lines.zh: 强到有时候她甚至会在我睡着的时候，在我床上自慰起来。

lines.en: Just normal family stuff, I suppose.
lines.zh: 大概就是普通的家庭日常吧。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv25
: I wish Makoto was like that.
lines.zh: : 我真希望 Makoto 也能那样。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like she doesn’t really care what I do.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我觉得她其实并不在乎我做什么。

lines.en: scene makifirstinv26
: Buuuut I’m not about to start complaining right before we leave.
lines.zh: : 但———我可不想在出门前开始抱怨。

lines.en: : I have wreaked enough havoc on your relationship with one [teenager] today, and I’ll be damned if I make you think less of Makoto by complaining or venting to you.
lines.zh: : 我今天已经把你和一位 [teenager] 的关系搅得够呛了，我绝不会再靠跟你抱怨、发牢骚来让你对 Makoto 印象变差。

lines.en: : I mean...if you really want to talk-
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果你真想聊-

lines.en: : You’ll hear me out and help me with my problems?
lines.zh: : 你会听我说完，还帮我解决问题？

lines.en: : The first part, sure. But if you ever have to come to me for help, you’re likely so far off the deep end that literally no one can help you anymore.
lines.zh: : 前半句没问题。不过要是哪天真沦落到要来找我帮忙，那你大概已经烂到谁都救不了的地步了。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah self-deprecation and sad stuff. I want meat. Let’s go get...barbecue or something.
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦吧啦，自贬加煽情。我想吃肉。我们去吃……烤肉什么的吧。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene black
: WAIT! NO! SENSEI! YOU HAVEN’T TOLD ME I CAN LEAVE MY ROOM YET!
lines.zh: : 等等！不！老师！你还没说我可以出房间呢！

lines.en: : Should you maybe let your [niece] out first? She might have to go to the bathroom at some point.
lines.zh: : 你要不要先把你 [niece] 放出来？她总会有想上厕所的时候吧。

lines.en: : She’ll be fine. She’s well behaved when she wants to be.
lines.zh: : 她没事的。她想乖的时候还是挺乖的。

lines.en: : NO! DON’T LEAVE ME!
lines.zh: : 不！别丢下我！

lines.en: : ESPECIALLY NOT WITH A MIYAMURA!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 更别把我跟一个 MIYAMURA 家的人留在一起！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: Maki and I make our way over to some restaurant close to her shop so that, once we’re done, she can head back home to sub in for Makoto.
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 去了她店附近的一家餐厅，这样吃完她就能直接回去替 Makoto 顶班。

lines.en: As it turns out, Maki was supposed to work tonight and Makoto was supposed to be helping Miku with something.
lines.zh: 原来今晚本该是 Maki 上班，而 Makoto 本该去帮 Miku 做什么事。

lines.en: But, of course, whenever I ask anyone to do anything, they almost always drop their previous plans for me.
lines.zh: 不过当然，只要我开口找人做什么，他们几乎总会为了我把原先的计划推掉。

lines.en: Just one of the perks of living in Kumon-mi, I guess.
lines.zh: 大概这也算是住在 Kumon-mi 的福利之一吧。

lines.en: Anyway, dinner is great and Maki winds up fronting the bill to pay for causing a disturbance at my house.
lines.zh: 总之，晚饭很棒，最后 Maki 抢着买了单，算是赔罪——为她在我家引起的那场骚动。

lines.en: Was it a disturbance I both expected and created by inviting her there? Yes. But it’s not like I’m going to give away a free dinner in exchange for admitting that.
lines.zh: 那场骚动是我早就预料到、甚至是我请她来才制造出来的吗？是的。但我可不会因为承认这点就白送自己一顿饭。

lines.en: Instead, I’ll just shelve that idea alongside the thousands of others that I have pushed away from me in a never ending journey toward complacency.
lines.zh: 相反，我会把这个念头束之高阁，和成千上万个被我推开的念头一起，踏上那条通往得过且过的无尽旅程。

lines.en: The two of us split apart-
lines.zh: 我们俩分道扬镳-

lines.en: And I go home to let my [niece] out of her cage.
lines.zh: 而我回家，把我 [niece] 从笼子里放出来。

lines.zh: Maki 的好感度提升到了 [maki_love]!
